title: desmodium varians var. gunnii
intro: Desmodium varians var. gunnii, commonly known as Variable Tick Trefoil, is a plant species in the legume family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and as a diuretic. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Desmodium varians var. gunnii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
